DIAGNOSIS READY: Polymyalgia Rheumatica (PMR)

Given the elevated inflammatory markers, normal X-ray, and MRI findings of mild synovitis without significant bursitis or rotator cuff tear, PMR is the most likely diagnosis considering your age and diabetes history. I would recommend starting treatment with low-dose corticosteroids and monitoring your symptoms closely.
